observations: Vintage-style sewing machine with a black head and yellow decorative decals.
The machine is mounted on a wooden table with a cast iron stand and a foot pedal.
A small motor is attached to the left side of the head.
The table has a wooden top and two drawers.
The machine is shown from multiple angles in the provided photos.

The presence of a motor and manual handwheel is visible, but the specific model and its operation are not confirmed.
Photo 3 shows a motor attached to the left side of the machine.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.
